title: Your Insurance Just Got a Digital Upgrade: What IRDAI Chief Ajay Seth is Planning
description: IRDAI Chairman Ajay Seth recently discussed big changes coming to how insurance is sold and managed in India. The regulator plans to cap commissions and expen.

faq.a: Ajay Seth is the current Chairman of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), which is the main regulatory body for the insurance sector in India.

faq.q: What is the Public Insurance Registry (PIR)?
faq.a: The Public Insurance Registry (PIR) is a proposed digital platform that will centralise and standardise all insurance policy information, making it easier for policyholders to access their details and for authorised entities to share data.

faq.q: When will these new insurance rules come into effect?
faq.a: The final timeline for the insurance distribution reforms (like commission caps) depends on industry feedback, but IRDAI is considering January 1 or April 1 next year. The beta version of the Public Insurance Registry is targeted for launch in January 2028.

faq.q: Will these changes affect all types of insurance?
faq.a: The proposed commission caps apply across more than 30 product and distribution-channel categories, suggesting a broad impact across various types of insurance products. The Public Insurance Registry aims to cover all insurance policy details.

faq.q: Where can I provide feedback on these proposed changes?
faq.a: IRDAI has an ongoing consultation process. The deadline for stakeholder feedback on the distribution reforms is October 25, 2026, and for the Public Insurance Registry consultation paper, it was October 17, 2026. You can usually find details on how to submit feedback on the official IRDAI website.
